cast_dialogue.linea: Heroes, the past has layers. The Past Perfect is your detective lens: it shows which action happened first.
When I arrived at the cinema, the film had already started. I had forgotten my wallet at home!
That happened to me too. By the time I got to the station, the train had left.
I had never missed a flight until last year. The plane had taken off before I reached the gate.
When you came to dinner last Sunday, I had already prepared everything. The past perfect keeps the story in order, mis héroes.

banco_oraciones.oracion: The train had already left when we arrived.
She had bought the ticket the night before.
They had finished dinner by eight o'clock.
I had never seen snow before that trip.
The film hadn't started when we arrived.
Had you ever flown before that trip?
What had happened before the police arrived?
Had she already eaten when you called?
Had the train left? Yes, it had.
Had they finished? No, they hadn't.
Had you seen the film before? No, I hadn't.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Use 'had + past participle' for the action that happened FIRST in a past story. It often goes with when, by the time, after, before, already, just, never. The Past Simple tells the second action.

filas: already, just, never, by the time
By the time she called, he had gone.

ejercicios.respuesta: When I arrived at the party, everybody had already eaten.

guion: Kenji: You look tired, Ben. What happened?
Ben: I missed the train this morning.
Ben: I had woken up late because I had forgotten to set my alarm.
Kenji: Hadn't you checked the timetable?
Ben: I had, but by the time I got to the station, the train had already left.
Kenji: Poor Ben! Next time, call me and I'll pick you up.

reading.texto: When Sofía arrived at the station, the train had already left. She was upset because she had bought the ticket the night before. Ben had waited for her for an hour, but he had gone home by the time she called. Luckily, Kenji had checked the timetable and had reserved seats on the next train. After they had finally arrived in the city, they met Abuela Carmen, who had prepared dinner for everyone.
